title: Preservation of the determinant-state invariant
statement: Let $p,Q,K$ be natural numbers with $p\le Q$, and let $s$ be a determinant state satisfying the invariant that its row count equals $m$, is at most $K$, every row has length at most $K$ and entries less than $Q$, the stored value $d$ is less than $Q$, and the counter $rc$ is at most $m$. Then one determinant step with parameter $p$ produces a state satisfying the same invariant.
hypotheses_covered: The state $s$ satisfies the stated invariant
